limits: Summon-clock updates and the separate deployment guard run. The deployment state-transition callback is intercepted. Complete state transitions, stun/control eligibility, child placement, allocation and lifetimes are not emulated.
The real empty-buff rate helper runs. Buff collection/ranking is not tested.
Clock profiles are explicit inputs matching archived rows; CSV inheritance and row loading are outside this fragment.

blocks.name: startColumn
blocks.interpretation: SpawnStartTime string at 0x61418c is cached at GOT+0x1850.

blocks.name: spawnColumns
blocks.interpretation: SpawnInterval, SpawnNumber and SpawnPauseTime cache at GOT+0x1854/1858/185c.

blocks.name: clockData
blocks.interpretation: The cached fields load into CharacterData+0x1e4/1e8/1ec/1f0.

blocks.name: clockGetters
blocks.interpretation: Read start, interval, count, pause and limit from CharacterData.

blocks.name: positiveStartOverride
blocks.interpretation: A strictly positive SpawnStartTime replaces that zero clock.

blocks.name: deploymentGuard
blocks.interpretation: A positive deployment countdown advances by 50 ms and returns while positive. State 8 also returns. Expiry notifies the intercepted state callback and can continue on the same update.

blocks.name: summonerClock
blocks.interpretation: Current eligible summon update: rate/2 decrement; one child per positive interval, otherwise a simultaneous group; count reset; add interval or pause, carrying remainder and clamping to one millisecond.
instructions: 216906:	e8 b1 f0 ff ff       	call   2159bc

blocks.name: emptyBuffRate
blocks.interpretation: An empty buff component produces rate 100; the clock update divides it by two, advancing 50 ms.

blocks.name: displayedCycle
blocks.interpretation: The native card-stat path computes SpawnPauseTime + (SpawnNumber - 1) * SpawnInterval.
